If you are in the area, please follow all evacuation orders and guidance from local fire authorities and Camp Pendleton.

evidence.span: A quick update from Newport Beach on the coastal flooding impacting our communities.

timeline.text:
A quick update from Newport Beach on the coastal flooding impacting our communities.

Thankfully, it appears the worst is behind us, thanks in large part to the tireless efforts of our local emergency response crews.

But a flood advisory remains in effect, and elevated tides continue to pose risks along our coastline. Please exercise caution and follow local safety guidance.

Governor Newsom’s emergency order remains in place, and my office will keep pushing to ensure Orange County receives the state and federal resources our communities need.
